decode_n50.signature: packs grid-capacity+1 into L=53/7: the K^2+1 architecture; the blob is an isostatic hand-polished arrangement, not a parametric family member

conclusion: P1(c) records are isostatic, hand-polished blobs at (mostly) Pythagorean angles on rational lattices — e.g. n=50: exact arctan(3/4), tilted centers on the 1/25 lattice, axis grid at 2/7 mod 1, L=53/7 exact, 105 contacts, K^2+1 signature.  They are NOT members of a low-dimensional parametric family: the run-25 method (decode->closed form->sweep) does not transfer.  The follow-up is a blob-regime INSERTION campaign (seed from the records themselves, insert one square at fixed L, pressure-settle) — named in NEXT_STEPS.md as the next P2 variant.
